messages.body: I liked that this changes when i move around and zoom, apply that effect to the rest of the hand-drawn ones

Every hand-drawn pin now redraws its line. That covers all states, the 2x previews and the second line on selected. Pins at rest redraw every 300 ms. A working agent's pin redraws every 120 ms, so it still stands out. I also updated the section text to match.
Have haiku rewrite this text with writing skill
Haiku rewrote the intro using the writing skill. It now covers the cursors row too, and drops the colour key because each state is already labelled under its icon. It fits in three lines.
We can add a comments button here!

Built in the app: a "Comments" button now sits here in the canvas top bar, after Shared CSS, with the open count. It opens a side panel with every comment, open and resolved. I didn't change this mock.
